en.headline: Arts in the Park grand finale parade brings giant fairy-tale puppets to Causeway Bay today
en.dek: The free outdoor festival organised by Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation continues at Victoria Park, with a 500-strong procession of 10 four-metre puppets starting at 2:30pm.
body: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026, Hong Kong’s largest outdoor youth arts festival, is holding its second day at Victoria Park in Causeway Bay today, with the Grand Finale Parade set to step off at 2:30pm.

Organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation, the free event celebrates classic fairy tales including Hansel and Gretel, Little Red Riding Hood, The Emperor’s New Clothes, Jack and the Beanstalk, Aladdin and The Happy Prince. Ten four-metre-tall giant puppets created by local students and artists will lead a procession of about 500 young performers, including students from around 100 schools and professional dancers, along Great George Street past Sogo and on to East Point Road before returning to the park.

The carnival runs from 10am to 5pm on the central lawn of Victoria Park, featuring 17 interactive arts booths, live storytelling in English and Cantonese, African drumming workshops, stage performances and an exhibition of more than 900 student artworks. Night Parade took place on Saturday evening in the Lee Gardens area.
Admission is free for all events. The festival is sponsored by the Standard Chartered Community Foundation and supported by the Hong Kong Tourism Board and the Wan Chai District Office.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華壓軸巡遊今午銅鑼灣登場 十座四米童話木偶領軍
zh.dek: 香港青年藝術協會主辦的免費戶外嘉年華在維園繼續舉行，下午2時30分約500人隊伍由十座巨型木偶帶領出發。
body: 渣打藝趣嘉年華2026今日在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園進入第二日，壓軸巡遊將於下午2時30分從維園出發。
由香港青年藝術協會主辦的免費活動以經典童話為主題，包括糖果屋、小紅帽、國王的新衣、傑克與魔豆、阿拉丁及快樂王子。十座由本地學生及藝術家製作、高達四米的巨型木偶，將帶領約500名青年表演者，包括來自約100間學校的學生及專業舞者，沿記利佐治街途經崇光百貨，再往東角道折返。
嘉年華於維園中央草坪上午10時至下午5時開放，設有17個互動藝術攤位、中英語故事劇場、非洲鼓樂坊、舞台表演，以及超過900件學生藝術作品展覽。周六晚已在利園區舉行夜光巡遊。
所有活動免費入場。嘉年華由渣打銀行慈善基金贊助，並獲香港旅遊發展局及灣仔民政事務處支持。
